sloka: कुतो वा ते भयम् जातम् या त्वमेवम्विदम् वरम् ।राष्ट्रे भरतमासीनम् वृणीषे राघवम् वने ॥२-१२-५८॥
transliteration: kuto vā te bhayam jātam yā tvamevamvidam varam ।rāṣṭre bharatamāsīnam vṛṇīṣe rāghavam vane ॥2-12-58॥

translations.english: You are asking for a boon that Bharata should be enthroned in the kingdom while Rama should live in the forest. From where did you get this apprehension?
